cohort: Mothers who gave birth via vaginal delivery (spontaneous or with epidural analgesia) or cesarean section (under general or spinal anesthesia)
finding: Mothers who had a spontaneous vaginal delivery had higher breastfeeding self-efficacy and breastfeeding success scores compared to mothers who gave birth via cesarean section or vaginal delivery with analgesia.
mod_finding: Mothers who had a spontaneous vaginal delivery had higher breastfeeding self-efficacy and breastfeeding success scores compared to mothers who gave birth via cesarean section or vaginal delivery with analgesia.
